example_translation: 阴暗的天空似乎表明要下雨了。

meaning: 漠不关心的, 无重要性的, 中立的; 中性的, 无作用的, 无亲和力的, 淡漠的
example: He seemed indifferent to the praise and kept on working quietly.
example_translation: 他对赞扬似乎漠不关心，继续安静工作。

meaning: 不可缺少之物; 不可缺少的, 责无旁贷的, 绝对必要的
example: A good dictionary is indispensable for careful language learners.
example_translation: 对认真的语言学习者来说，一本好词典不可缺少。

meaning: 人, 个人, 个体; 个别的, 个人的, 独特的
example: Each individual in the class chose a book to read.
example_translation: 班上的每个人都选了一本书来读。

meaning: 户内的, 室内的
example: Bad weather moved the game to an indoor court.
example_translation: 天气不好，比赛改到了室内球场。

meaning: 引诱, 招致, 归纳出, 感应; 诱导, 感应
example: Nothing could induce him to change his careful daily plan.
example_translation: 什么也不能诱使他改变自己细致的每日计划。

meaning: 勤劳, 工业, 企业, 产业, 有组织的劳动; 工业, 实业
example: The film industry in this area has grown very fast.
example_translation: 这个地区的电影产业发展得非常快。

meaning: 不可避免的, 必然的; 不可避免的, 无法规避的, 必然的
example: Some small mistakes are inevitable when we learn a new skill.
example_translation: 学一项新技能时，有些小错是不可避免的。

meaning: 婴儿, 儿童, 初学者; 婴儿的, 幼稚的
example: The infant slept quietly in the soft light of the room.
example_translation: 婴儿在房间柔和的光线里安静地睡着。

meaning: 传染, 感染
example: The virus can infect people through a simple handshake.
example_translation: 这种病毒可以通过简单的握手传染给人。

meaning: 推论出, 推断; 作推论
example: From her smile we could infer that she had passed.
example_translation: 从她的微笑我们可以推断她通过了。

meaning: 次等的, 较差的, 下方的, 下级的; 部下, 次品, 下标(符号)
example: The cheaper cloth felt inferior to the one she chose.
example_translation: 这种便宜的布料摸起来不如她选的那种好。

meaning: 无限, 神; 无穷的, 无限的, 极大的
example: The night sky seems to hold an infinite number of stars.
example_translation: 夜空似乎拥有无数颗星星。

meaning: 使膨胀, 使得意, 使通货膨胀, 使充气; 充气, 膨胀
example: The children helped to inflate the big balloon by the door.
example_translation: 孩子们帮忙给门口的大气球充了气。

meaning: 影响力, 权力, 势力; 影响, 改变
example: His old teacher had a deep influence on his choice.
example_translation: 他的老师对他的选择有很深的影响。

meaning: 流行性感冒; 流行性感冒, 流感
example: She stayed in bed for a week because of influenza.
example_translation: 因为流感，她在床上躺了一个星期。

meaning: 通知, 使了解, 使充满; 提供资料, 告发
example: Please inform the office if you plan to arrive late.
example_translation: 如果你打算晚到，请通知办公室。

meaning: 基础结构, 基础设施; 基础设施
example: The city is spending more money on roads and other infrastructure.
example_translation: 这座城市正在道路和其他基础设施上投入更多资金。

meaning: 成分, 因素; 配合剂; 拼料; 成分; 组分
example: Flour is the main ingredient in this simple bread recipe.
example_translation: 面粉是这个简单面包食谱中的主要原料。

meaning: 居住于, 占据, 栖息
example: Many small animals inhabit the quiet woods behind our house.
example_translation: 许多小动物栖息在我们屋后的安静树林里。

meaning: 继承, 遗传; 接受遗产
example: She will inherit the old family house from her aunt.
example_translation: 她将从姑妈那里继承那栋老房子。

meaning: 字首, 首字母; 开始的, 最初的, 字首的; 用姓名的首字母签名
example: My initial plan was to walk, but I took the bus.
example_translation: 我最初打算走路，但后来坐了公交车。

meaning: 入会, 开始; 新加入的; 开始, 传授基本知识给
example: They decided to initiate a small reading group at school.
example_translation: 他们决定在学校发起一个小的读书小组。

meaning: 伤害, 损害, 使受冤屈; 损伤
example: He injured his knee while playing football on Saturday.
example_translation: 周六踢足球时他伤了膝盖。

meaning: 墨水, 墨汁; 涂墨水于, 签署, 加墨水
example: The ink on the old letter had faded to brown.
example_translation: 那封旧信上的墨水已经褪成了褐色。

meaning: 内陆的, 国内的; 内地
example: They drove inland to visit a quiet town in the hills.
example_translation: 他们开车去内陆，探访山间一个安静的小镇。

meaning: 旅馆, 客栈; 住旅馆
example: We spent one night at a small inn near the river.
example_translation: 我们在河边一家小客栈住了一晚。

meaning: 内部的, 内心的; 内部
example: The inner room stays cool even on the hottest days.
example_translation: 即使在最热的日子，里面的房间也很凉爽。

meaning: 无罪的, 不懂事的, 无知的; 天真的人, 笨蛋
example: The child looked innocent as she asked her simple question.
example_translation: 那孩子问出那个简单问题时，看上去天真无邪。

meaning: 改革, 创新
example: Small teams often innovate faster than large ones do.
example_translation: 小团队往往比大团队创新得更快。

meaning: 输入, 输入电路; 输入
example: Your input would help us improve this simple plan.
example_translation: 你的意见会帮助我们改进这个简单的计划。

meaning: 询问, 问明, 查究
example: She called the office to inquire about the new course schedule.
example_translation: 她打电话到办公室询问新课程的安排。

meaning: 患精神病的, 极愚蠢的; 神经错乱的
example: Driving that old car without brakes seems completely insane to me.
example_translation: 开着那辆没有刹车的旧车，在我看来完全是疯了。

meaning: 昆虫, 卑鄙的人; 昆虫
example: A small insect landed on the leaf and stayed there quietly.
example_translation: 一只小昆虫落在叶子上，静静地待在那里。

meaning: 插入物; 插入, 把(人造卫星)射入(轨道), 添写; 附着; 插入
example: Please insert the key into the lock and turn it slowly.
example_translation: 请把钥匙插进锁里，然后慢慢转动。

meaning: 内部, 内脏, 内幕; 内部的, 秘密的, 户内的; 在里面; 在...之内
example: The children waited inside the house until the rain stopped.
example_translation: 孩子们在屋里等到雨停。

meaning: 察看, 洞察力, 见识; 自知力, 洞察, 顿悟
example: Her book gives useful insight into how young children learn language.
example_translation: 她的书对幼儿如何学习语言提供了有用的见解。

meaning: 坚持, 坚决主张, 强调
example: He will insist on paying for dinner whenever we meet.
example_translation: 每次见面他都坚持要付晚餐的钱。

meaning: 检查, 检阅, 检验; 检查
example: Workers inspect every machine before the factory starts its daily run.
example_translation: 工人在工厂每天开工前检查每一台机器。

meaning: 使感动, 激发, 启示, 吸入, 鼓舞, 产生, 使生灵感; 吸入, 赋予灵感
example: Her quiet courage inspired the whole team to keep working.
example_translation: 她那份沉静的勇气鼓舞了整个团队继续努力。

meaning: 任命, 使就任, 使就职, 安装, 装置, 设置, 安顿, 安置
example: The workers will instal the new lights in the hall tomorrow.
example_translation: 工人们明天会在大厅里安装新的灯。

meaning: 就职, 装设, 分期付款
example: They are paying for the car in monthly instalments over three years.
example_translation: 他们用三年时间按月分期付款买这辆车。

meaning: 建议, 情况, 例子, 场合; 引以为例, 举例说明
example: In this instance, the best choice is to wait and see.
example_translation: 在这种情况下，最好的选择是等着看看。

meaning: 立即, 瞬间; 紧急的, 立即的, 即时的
example: The moment she heard the news, her face changed in an instant.
example_translation: 一听到这个消息，她的脸色瞬间就变了。

meaning: 作为替代, 反而
example: The shop was closed, so we went to a cafe instead.
example_translation: 商店关门了，所以我们改去了一家咖啡馆。

meaning: 本能, 直觉; 充满着的
example: Birds follow their instinct and fly south before the cold arrives.
example_translation: 鸟类依循本能，在寒冷来临前飞往南方。

meaning: 学会, 学院, 协会; 创立, 开始, 制定, 任命
example: The institute offers free evening classes to local school teachers.
example_translation: 该学院为当地学校教师提供免费的夜校课程。

meaning: 机构, 惯例, 制度; 机关, 机构, 设施
example: This old library is an important institution in our small town.
example_translation: 这座老图书馆是我们小镇上一个重要的机构。

meaning: 教, 教育, 命令, 通知; 托办, 指导, 指示
example: The teacher instructed the students to read the chapter at home.
example_translation: 老师指示学生在家读这一章。

meaning: 工具, 手段, 仪器; 仪器
example: The doctor used a small instrument to check my eyes carefully.
example_translation: 医生用一种小仪器仔细检查了我的眼睛。

meaning: 侮辱, 无礼, 损害; 损害, 侮辱, 攻击
example: He did not mean to insult you with that silly remark.
example_translation: 他并不是想用那句蠢话侮辱你。

meaning: 保险, 确保; 投保
example: We insure our house against flood and storm damage every year.
example_translation: 我们每年都为房子投保水灾和风暴损失险。

meaning: 尚未被人碰过的, 原封不动的, 完整的; 完整的, 无伤的
example: The old letter was still intact after fifty years in the drawer.
example_translation: 这封旧信在抽屉里放了五十年，仍然完好无损。

meaning: 入口, 吸入, 吸入量; 摄取量
example: Doctors say a daily intake of fresh fruit helps your health.
example_translation: 医生说每天摄入新鲜水果对健康有益。

meaning: 难以明了的, 无形的; 无形的
example: Trust between people is an intangible value that money cannot buy.
example_translation: 人与人之间的信任是金钱买不到的无形价值。

meaning: 综合, 使完整, 使成整体; 成一体; 完整的, 完全的
example: The school helps new students integrate into class life quickly.
example_translation: 学校帮助新同学很快融入班级生活。

meaning: 正直, 廉正, 完整; 完整性
example: Everyone trusted him because of his honesty and personal integrity.
example_translation: 由于他诚实并且为人正直，大家都很信任他。

meaning: 有知识者, 知识分子, 凭理智做事者; 智力的, 用脑力的, 聪明的
example: The club attracts intellectual people who enjoy long talks about books.
example_translation: 这个俱乐部吸引着喜欢长时间谈论书籍的有才智的人。

meaning: 聪明的, 智能的, 了解的
example: Our new dog is intelligent enough to open the kitchen door.
example_translation: 我们新养的狗聪明得能打开厨房的门。

meaning: 计划, 打算, 意思是; 想要, 打算, 意旨
example: We intend to visit the museum on Saturday morning if it rains.
example_translation: 如果下雨，我们打算周六上午去参观博物馆。

meaning: 非常的, 强烈的, 紧张的, 热情的; 强的
example: The heat was so intense that we stayed indoors all afternoon.
example_translation: 天气热得厉害，我们整个下午都待在室内。

meaning: 加强的, 内涵的, 集中的; 加强器
example: She joined an intensive course to improve her spoken English.
example_translation: 她参加了一个密集课程来提高英语口语。

meaning: 互相影响, 交互作用; 幕间剧, 幕间休息
example: Children learn to interact with each other through simple group games.
example_translation: 孩子们通过简单的集体游戏学会相互交流。

meaning: 兴趣, 嗜好, 利息, 利益, 爱好, 趣味, 势力; 使感兴趣, 与...有关系
example: He lost interest in the game after the first hour.
example_translation: 第一个小时过后他就对这场比赛失去了兴趣。

meaning: 妨碍, 冲突, 干涉, 抵触; 干扰, 干涉, 阻碍, 碰腿(马)
example: Please do not interfere while the workers are repairing the road.
example_translation: 工人们在修路时请不要妨碍他们。

meaning: 内部, 内政; 内部的, 心灵的, 内地的, 内政的
example: The interior of the old house was warm and simply furnished.
example_translation: 这座老房子的内部温暖而且布置简朴。

meaning: 中间物, 调停者, 中级; 中间的, 中级的; 起媒介作用; 中级
example: This book is for intermediate learners who already know basic grammar.
example_translation: 这本书适合已经掌握基础语法的中级学习者。

meaning: 内在的, 国内的; 内的, 内部的
example: The company holds internal meetings every Friday to share progress.
example_translation: 公司每周五召开内部会议，分享进展。

meaning: 国际的; 国别设定
example: The city hosts an international film festival every autumn.
example_translation: 这座城市每年秋天举办国际电影节。

meaning: 因特网, 国际互连网, 网际网络, 互连网络, 广域网
example: I found the answer on the Internet after a short search.
example_translation: 我在因特网上简短搜索后找到了答案。

meaning: 解释, 演出, 翻译, 理解; 翻译, 解释
example: Can you interpret what this old poem really means?
example_translation: 你能解释这首古老的诗真正是什么意思吗？

meaning: 中断, 妨碍, 插嘴; 打断; 中断
example: Please do not interrupt me while I am on the phone.
example_translation: 我打电话时请不要打断我。

meaning: 间隔, 距离, 间歇, 间隙; 时间间隔
example: Buses leave the station at an interval of twenty minutes.
example_translation: 公交车每隔二十分钟从车站发出一班。

meaning: 面谈, 访问, 接见, 面试; 接见, 对...进行面谈(试)
example: She has an interview with a local company next Monday.
example_translation: 她下周一和一家本地公司有一场面试。

meaning: 亲密的, 私人的, 秘密的; 暗示, 通知, 告诉; 至交
example: They have been intimate friends since their first year at school.
example_translation: 他们从在学校的第一年起就是亲密的朋友。

meaning: 进入...之内, 朝..., 深入...之中, 成为...状况
example: She walked into the kitchen and poured herself a glass of water.
example_translation: 她走进厨房，给自己倒了一杯水。

meaning: 介绍, 引入, 采用, 输入; 引进, 输入, 介绍
example: Let me introduce you to my sister before dinner starts.
example_translation: 晚饭开始前让我把你介绍给我姐姐。

meaning: 闯入, 侵入; 强加于
example: I do not want to intrude, but may I ask a question?
example_translation: 我不想打扰，不过我可以问一个问题吗？

meaning: 侵入, 拥入, 侵略, 侵袭; 强入, 侵犯, 侵略
example: Weeds slowly invade the garden if nobody pulls them out.
example_translation: 如果没人把杂草拔掉，它们会慢慢侵入花园。

meaning: 病人, 残废者; 有病的, 无效的
example: Your ticket is invalid after the date printed on it.
example_translation: 你的票在打印的日期之后就无效了。

meaning: 无价的, 价值无法衡量的
example: Her advice was invaluable when I planned the whole trip.
example_translation: 我规划整趟旅行时，她的建议非常宝贵。

meaning: 不变化地, 恒定地, 始终如一地
example: He invariably arrives ten minutes early for every morning meeting.
example_translation: 每次晨会他都无一例外地提前十分钟到。

meaning: 发明, 创作, 虚构; 发明
example: Nobody knows who invented the first simple water clock.
example_translation: 没人知道是谁发明了第一台简易水钟。

meaning: 投资, 花费, 笼罩, 授予; 投资, 利用
example: They decided to invest their savings in a small local business.
example_translation: 他们决定把积蓄投资到一家本地小企业。

meaning: 调查, 审查
example: Engineers will investigate the cause of the strange noise.
example_translation: 工程师将调查这种奇怪噪音的原因。

meaning: 看不见的, 无形的; 无形的, 表面上看不见的, 未列在公开帐目的
example: The bird was almost invisible against the grey winter sky.
example_translation: 那只鸟在灰蒙蒙的冬日天空下几乎看不见。

meaning: 邀请, 请求, 引起, 招致; 邀请
example: We plan to invite our neighbours for tea on Sunday.
example_translation: 我们打算周日请邻居来喝茶。

meaning: 包括, 使陷于, 潜心于, 包围; 累及, 牵涉, 包含
example: The job involves a lot of travel to other cities.
example_translation: 这份工作需要经常去其他城市出差。

meaning: 内心的, 向内的, 本来的; 向内的
example: He took a deep inward breath before speaking to the crowd.
example_translation: 他深深吸了一口气，然后才向人群讲话。

meaning: 铁, 熨斗, 铁器, 坚强, 烙铁, 镣铐; 烫平, 熨, 用铁包; 烫平
example: She used a hot iron to press the shirt flat.
example_translation: 她用热熨斗把衬衫烫平。

meaning: 反语, 讽刺, 具有讽刺意味的事
example: The irony is that the writer forgot his own book at home.
example_translation: 具有讽刺意味的是，这位作家把自己的书忘在了家里。

meaning: 无理数; 无理性的, 不合理的
example: It seems irrational to buy a new phone every single year.
example_translation: 每年都买一部新手机似乎是不合理的。

meaning: 不规则物, 不合规格之物; 不规则的, 不整齐的, 不合法的
example: Her working hours are irregular, so she rarely eats on time.
example_translation: 她的工作时间不规律，所以她很少按时吃饭。

meaning: 灌溉, 冲洗伤口, 使清新; 灌溉
example: Farmers irrigate their fields with water from the small river.
example_translation: 农民用小河里的水灌溉田地。

meaning: 岛, 岛屿, 孤立地区, 安全岛; 使成岛状, 孤立
example: A small island sits in the middle of the quiet lake.
example_translation: 平静的湖中央有一座小岛。

meaning: 使隔离, 使孤立, 使绝缘; 隔离种群
example: The snowstorm isolated the village from the rest of the country.
example_translation: 暴风雪使这个村庄与国内其他地方隔绝。

meaning: 发行, 问题, 后果, 流出, 出口, 争端; 发行, 流出, 造成...结果, 传下; 使流出, 放出, 发行, 发布, 发给
example: The main issue at the meeting was the rising cost of rent.
example_translation: 会上主要的问题是不断上涨的房租。

meaning: 它; 信息论, 输入终端, 智能终端, 内捕获
example: It was already dark when we finally reached the hotel.
example_translation: 我们终于到旅馆时天已经黑了。

meaning: 项目, 条款, 一则, 项; 项
example: Each item on the list costs less than ten dollars.
example_translation: 清单上的每一项都不到十美元。

meaning: 它的
example: The cat licked its paws and then fell asleep by the window.
example_translation: 猫舔了舔爪子，然后在窗边睡着了。

meaning: 它本身, 它自己
example: The old machine stopped by itself in the middle of the night.
example_translation: 那台旧机器半夜自己停了下来。

meaning: 夹克, 外套, 护套; 给...穿夹克, 给...装护套
example: He hung his jacket on the chair and sat down.
example_translation: 他把外套挂在椅子上，然后坐了下来。

meaning: 监牢, 监狱, 拘留所; 监禁, 下狱
